title.zh: 【币安热钱包价值超 25 亿美元资产疑似被盗】
title.en: 【币安热钱包价值超 25 亿美元资产疑似被盗】

current_state.zh: On-chain observers flagged an abnormal outflow of more than $2.5 billion from Binance hot wallets into new addresses initially funded through Tornado Cash, in what is being treated as a suspected major theft.
